sources.entry: AltTab - AltTab brings the power of Windows alt-tab to macOS.

summary.one_liner: AltTab is a macOS app that brings Windows-style alt-tab window switching to macOS.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not available, so this summary relies on the repository metadata only. The repository is listed in an awesome-style list of open-source macOS apps under Window Management. Based on its name and the listing description, it provides Windows-like alt-tab window switching on macOS. Features, setup steps, and supported macOS versions could not be verified from the README.
use_cases: switch between open windows with the keyboard
replace the default macOS app switcher
notable: Brings Windows-style alt-tab window switching to macOS
Listed among open-source macOS window management apps
caveats: README not available, so features and requirements are unverified
